# ADR-3037: A04: Rate-limit configuration for public route 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing rate limits enable abuse and credential stuffing.

## Decision

Edge configuration MUST declare a rate-limit configuration for public route 1 (A04-1).

## Consequences

Limits are tuned per authenticity risk.
